schema_new_fields.definition: revenue - cargo-variable costs (handling + transshipment + per-TEU port variable); profit = contribution margin - fixed service cost (vessel + fuel + port calls)
network carried TEU-legs / offered TEU-legs (capacity-weighted); also *_service_unweighted and *_vessel_weighted
lowest / highest service load factor (each vessel inherits its service's value); leg_min / leg_max over single legs
TEU-weighted mean transit time of the routed flows (sailing + port stays + transfer dwell); mean_per_flow is unweighted
shortest / longest transit time over the routed flows; p50, p90, mean_direct, mean_transshipped also stored
TEU of flows that change service at least once
TEU x number of transfers (a two-transfer container counts twice)
the pipeline call end to end (includes LLM calls and every stage)
the driver's wall time around the whole test process (adds start-up and report writing)
network plan stage only (paths, MILP, local search, flow re-optimisation, ledger)
summed latency of the LLM calls; components may overlap, so it can exceed the wall time
rate-limited LLM calls and rule-based fallbacks; the run continues on the fallback
